  • Tachyon cannot deal the final blow

If anything, I agree it's the bounty rule that is not nailed down. What seems possible is that if the bounty is played on a target that's not Ambuscade, and that target is destroyed, than there is no unlock. We have seen bounties in Chrono-Ranger's trash, however, so that is not it on its own.

There are a few other possibilities that haven't been tested:

1) It might only be villain targets that can't be targets of a bounty. In that case, we should try placing a bounty on Villainous Weaponry and destroying Villainous Weaponry to trigger the bounty.

2) I believe someone has tested destroying bounties from play using Blinding Speed and other such cards. I don't know if anyone has tested doing it with Jim's Hat. It could be that none of Chrono-Ranger's cards may destroy a bounty.

3) It could be that no target besides Ambuscade may be destroyed if a bounty is beside it. This is important because "The Ultimate Target" does not destroy itself when the target it is placed beside is destroyed, so you can still fulfill the bounty but not have the bounty destroyed.

 

To narrow down these possibilities, you should try violating all 3 of these rules at once. If no unlock occurs, we know one of these rules is the one to use. Then, we violate 2 of the rules to narrow it down further. And if no unlock occurs, then we only violate one of those 2 rules to nail it down.

To violate all 3 rules:

1) Play a bounty on a villain target that is not Ambuscade and then destory it with Jim's Hat.

2) Play any bounty besides "The Ultimate Target" on Villainous Weaponry and then destory Villainous Weaponry.

3) Play "The Ultimate Target" on any villain target that is not Ambuscade and then destroy that target.

And also follow all the standard rules: Tachyon must not be incapacitated, Tachyon and Chrono-Ranger cannot incapacitate Ambuscade, do not destory any targets with a bounty beside it. (besides Ambuscade)

The more I think about it, it's likely:

Defeat Ambuscade at Wagner Mars Base. Tachyon and Chrono-Ranger must be on the team and neither may deliver the final blow to Ambuscade. No targets with a bounty beside them may be destroyed, except Ambuscade. Tachyon must not be incapacitated.
